title: The Last Train
location: A small railway platform at blue hour. Warm station windows, a wooden bench, quiet rails and violet hills. No other people.

cues.speaker: mara
cues.text: The last train was supposed to leave eight minutes ago.

cues.speaker: eli
cues.text: Then I am either very late or unexpectedly lucky.
cues.action: Eli rests his instrument case beside the bench.

cues.speaker: mara
cues.text: You are holding a ticket for yesterday.
cues.action: She points at the date, without taking the ticket.

cues.speaker: eli
cues.text: That would explain the unusually quiet carriage.
cues.action: He turns the ticket over, then admits the joke with a smile.

cues.speaker: mara
cues.text: Please tell me you did not spend the night on a parked train.
cues.action: Her smile fades; she studies his face.

cues.speaker: eli
cues.text: Only the evening. I was tuning the piano in the station café.
cues.action: He taps the small case: tools, not luggage.

cues.speaker: mara
cues.text: They closed that café last winter.
cues.action: A gust moves the hanging station sign.

cues.speaker: eli
cues.text: I know. My sister used to play there. I promised I would keep it in tune.
cues.action: He looks toward the dark café windows.
cues.delivery: Hushed and intimate; pause after I know.

cues.speaker: mara
cues.text: They should have left you a light.
cues.action: Mara looks toward the locked office, angry on his behalf.
cues.delivery: Quiet anger on his behalf, controlled.

cues.speaker: eli
cues.text: There was enough moonlight. Not enough coffee.
cues.action: He lifts his shoulders; she lets out a small laugh.
cues.delivery: Warm dry humor; pause before coffee.

cues.speaker: mara
cues.text: Come inside. I have coffee, and the morning timetable.
cues.action: She unlocks the warm-lit office door.
cues.delivery: Warmly inviting, with a small smile.

cues.speaker: eli
cues.text: Then perhaps this is the right ticket after all.
cues.action: They turn toward the light together.

stagingNotes: Position Mara slightly left and Eli slightly right in the central foreground, leaving space between them to show their interaction and emotional connection.
Ensure warm ochre light from the station windows casts soft illumination on the characters' faces and clothing, contrasting with the cool dusk indigo background.
Focus on expressive facial features with clear, readable eyebrows and mouths to convey subtle emotions, maintaining consistent proportions and simplified graphic-novel figures.
